{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Identify the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient
# This ensures we keep the most recent test for each patient
trial_df = trial_df.loc[trial_df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Verify the result
print(f"Number of unique patients after deduplication: {trial_df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check the distribution of severity after deduplication
print(f"Severity distribution after deduplication:\n{trial_df['severity'].value_counts()}")"}
